lessons_used: Evidence is still thin for adoption new_screen, finish new_screen, finish redesign, home new_flow, and sign_in hint, as each category has only one test.
Adoption redesign is a helpful change, supported by a confirmed statistically significant win in round 3.
No clear effect was seen for choose_path copy across 3 tests, home wait_info across 2 tests, or sign_in reorder across 2 tests.
Finish notification changes showed no clear effect in one test and caused a significant drop in another, requiring an early stop.
Predictions were frequently overly optimistic for minor tweaks, yet severely underestimated major positive outcomes like the winning adoption redesign.

candidates.title: Pet Trait and Appearance Stage Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the friend selection screen into a stage layout with animated pet previews and interactive choice cards.
candidates.why: Adoption stage redesigns proved statistically significant in previous rounds, and 3 users reported issues with custom pet appearance.

pick_friend.headline: Choose Your Desk Companion
pick_friend.body: Select the personality and look that best matches your workspace vibe.

guard.reason: replacement for 'pick_friend.pet_choices' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['choice_cards'] with real words

candidates.title: Interactive Desktop Controls Onboarding Screen
candidates.change: Adds a dedicated interactive guide screen right before home_intro showing how to summon, move, and hide the pet on the desktop.
candidates.why: Finish completion is low (64.8%, mean 5815s) and multiple support emails noted confusion on controlling, hiding, or finding the pet on desktop.

new_desktop_guide.headline: Mastering Your Desktop Companion
new_desktop_guide.body: Learn the basic gestures to interact, reposition, or hide your companion anytime.

components.text: Click pet to interact | Drag pet to reposition | Right-click to hide

guard.reason: text in 'new_desktop_guide.components[1].text' has characters outside the allowed set: ['|']

candidates.title: Guided Companion Path Selection Flow
candidates.change: Replaces static path selection with a interactive question flow screen to guide users to their ideal pet path.
candidates.why: 23.8% of users drop off at choose_path taking an average of 514s, indicating hesitation when selecting a companion type.

new_path_quiz.headline: Find Your Ideal Desk Partner
new_path_quiz.body: Answer two quick questions so we can match you with the perfect companion archetype.

guard.reason: Adds quiz sub-flow while preserving choose_path and all required steps.

candidates.score_note: Interactive path guide addresses 23.8% dropoff on choose_path, but requires creating new screens.

candidates.title: Desktop Welcome Screen Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns home_intro into a clean spotlight view with a direct start button and desktop shortcut prompt.
candidates.why: Finish step dropoff is high (35.2% drop) and 3 support tickets complained that the pet failed to appear after completion.

home_intro.headline: Your Companion Has Arrived!
home_intro.body: Your desktop pet is now active on your screen. Click below to start interacting.

guard.reason: replacement for 'home_intro.home_welcome' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['animation', 'image', 'mascot', 'text'] with real words

candidates.title: Existing Account Recovery Warning Hint
candidates.change: Adds an explicit hint on the sign-in screen reminding users to sign into their original account to preserve previous pets.
candidates.why: 8 support emails (the top support issue) reported pets missing or reset after signing into a secondary account.

sign_in.hint: Note: Sign in with your existing account email to keep your previous pets and achievements intact.

guard.reason: text in 'sign_in.hint' asks for or mentions personal data

candidates.title: Hatching Progress Live Tip Carousel
candidates.change: Adds a tip carousel and estimated time indicator on the waiting screen during pet rendering.
candidates.why: Home/waiting stage has the longest wait times (median 201s, mean 2336s), leading to user dropoff while pet graphics build.

components.text: Did you know? You can right-click your pet on the desktop to change its outfit!

guard.reason: Adds tip carousel and real-wait time estimate during pet rendering.

candidates.score_note: Home wait_info tested twice previously with no clear positive effect (-1.1% average).

candidates.title: Photo Upload Guidance Copy Enhancement
candidates.change: Updates headline, body, and hint text on the photo upload screen with clear lighting and framing instructions.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failures or distorted custom pets due to poor input photos.

upload_photos.headline: Upload a Clear, Well-Lit Photo
upload_photos.body: For best results, use a front-facing photo with good lighting and a simple background.
upload_photos.hint: Supported formats: JPG, PNG. Avoid blurry or dark images for accurate pet generation.

guard.reason: Asks for personal information by requiring a photo of the user.

candidates.title: Pet Naming Confirmation Screen
candidates.change: Inserts a dedicated companion naming screen right before generating the adoption certificate.
candidates.why: Adoption stage has a high median time (89s) and adding an emotional connection screen improves commitment before lengthy generation.

new_naming_screen.headline: Give Your New Companion a Name
new_naming_screen.body: What should your desk pet be called? You can change this anytime later.

guard.reason: 'new_naming_screen.components[0]': inputs may only ask for the pet's name

candidates.title: Centered Intro Story Screen Layout
candidates.change: Changes the initial story screen layout to centered with prominent visual branding.
candidates.why: First step dropoff at choose_path is 23.8%; an engaging initial layout establishes prompt app value.

story.headline: Welcome to Your New Desktop World
story.body: Adopt a digital companion that lives right on your desktop, keeps you company, and brightens your workday.

guard.reason: Updates story screen layout while continuing to introduce the pet.

candidates.score_note: Minor visual layout tweak unlikely to overcome hesitation at path selection based on past lessons.

candidates.title: Desktop Ready System Notification
candidates.change: Enables OS system notification switch when pet background rendering completes during the waiting screen.
candidates.why: Mean waiting time is over 38 minutes (2336s), causing users to switch away to other desktop apps while waiting.

waiting.hint: You will receive a desktop notification when your pet finishes hatching!

guard.reason: Adds notification trigger on waiting screen during pet rendering.

candidates.score_note: Addresses extreme 38-minute wait time, but notification changes showed poor results in prior tests.

lessons_next: Evidence is still thin for adoption new_screen, choose_path new_flow, finish new_screen, finish redesign, home new_flow, home notification, and sign_in hint, as each category has only one test.
Adoption redesign is a helpful change, supported by a confirmed statistically significant win in round 3.
No clear effect was seen for choose_path copy across 3 tests, home wait_info across 2 tests, or sign_in reorder across 2 tests.
Finish notification changes showed no clear positive effect, with one test showing no clear effect and another causing a severe drop that required an early stop.
